correctness.rationale: Each coordinate axis is invariant because both drift and diffusion contain the corresponding state as a factor. On each axis the equation is exactly geometric Brownian motion, giving the closed p-th moment exponent p a_i + p(p-1) sigma^2/2. Therefore p-moment exponential stability of the full origin necessarily forces all three axis exponents to be negative. For the source's Parameter Set 1, a_x=-2.8. With unrestricted sigma=3, source inequalities (16)-(18) hold on the x-axis but the exact second-moment exponent is 3.4>0. The almost-sure exponent -7.3 is also computed exactly, confirming the distinction between pathwise and moment decay.

value.rationale: The finding changes a qualitative stability conclusion in a recent stochastic supply-chain game: the published conditions cannot certify moment stability without controlling noise intensity. The exact boundary calculation is mathematically decisive, uses the source's own parameter set, and exposes a practically important distinction between almost-sure convergence and exploding second moments. This is not a cosmetic coefficient correction; it changes which stochastic stability claims are supported by the model.
